$comment: The research routines in claude.ai (SPEC-agent § The routine). This file is the record; claude.ai holds the live copy. To change a model or a time: edit here, merge, then ask Claude Code to apply agent/routines.json (it updates each trigger with RemoteTrigger). Cron is UTC (#14); packages/core's ROUTINE_RUNS_UTC must list every fire time, and a test checks it. Every routine sends agent/routine-stub.md, which reads agent/routine-prompt.md from main.
